description: `deps=[]` is fetch-on-mount only: the body reads @userId, but the explicit empty list suppresses inference — setting @userId to 2 does not re-fetch, so the name stays user 1's.
rationale: §6.7.7: "When present, `deps` overrides inference." + the SPEC example `<request id="config" deps=[]>` "Fetch on mount only — no reactive deps".
